title: Mushroom
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- stem -->
  <rect x='38' y='52' width='24' height='34' rx='6' fill='#f2e8c9'/>
  <rect x='38' y='52' width='8' height='34' rx='6' fill='#e0d3ae'/>
  <!-- stem base shadow -->
  <rect x='36' y='80' width='28' height='8' rx='4' fill='#d4c49a'/>
  <!-- cap -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='46' rx='36' ry='26' fill='#e03b2e'/>
  <!-- cap lighter rim -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='46' rx='36' ry='26' fill='none' stroke='#ff6b5e' stroke-width='4'/>
  <!-- cap underside -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='56' rx='30' ry='10' fill='#c42d22'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='54' rx='29' ry='8' fill='#f5d9b0'/>
  <!-- white spots -->
  <ellipse cx='36' cy='34' rx='8' ry='6' fill='#fff4e0'/>
  <ellipse cx='60' cy='30' rx='6' ry='5' fill='#fff4e0'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='42' rx='5' ry='4' fill='#fff4e0'/>
  <ellipse cx='70' cy='44' rx='6' ry='4' fill='#fff4e0'/>
  <ellipse cx='28' cy='48' rx='5' ry='4' fill='#fff4e0'/>
  <!-- cute face on stem -->
  <circle cx='44' cy='64' r='2.5' fill='#6b4a2a'/>
  <circle cx='56' cy='64' r='2.5' fill='#6b4a2a'/>
  <path d='M45 70 Q50 74 55 70' stroke='#6b4a2a' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- cheek blush -->
  <circle cx='40' cy='69' r='3' fill='#f0a08a' opacity='0.7'/>
  <circle cx='60' cy='69' r='3' fill='#f0a08a' opacity='0.7'/>
</svg>
